reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal establishes tiered JitoSOL stake delegation to validators adopting BAM software, with eligibility criteria (3 epochs continuous operation, uptime within 3% of chain max, JIP-27 compliance) and tier activation based on adoption thresholds. Requests temporary six-month Steward parameter control. No direct treasury expenditure.
reasoning_trace.inference: This is stake reallocation rather than treasury outflow. Need to verify whether tier thresholds, allocation amounts, and control assignment are specified.

reasoning_trace.observation: Author is drnick. Validators running BAM are beneficiaries. Jito Foundation mentioned as reporting party for BAM adoption verification. Directed Staking infrastructure administers program.
reasoning_trace.inference: Proposer and affected groups are clear. Jito Foundation has oversight role.

reasoning_trace.step: Scan tier thresholds and allocation amounts
reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal states 'tiered delegation triggers scaling with adoption metrics' and 'Each tier activates upon BAM stakeweight reaching specified thresholds' but provides no numeric thresholds or JitoSOL allocation amounts per tier.
reasoning_trace.inference: Critical parameters are missing. Delegates cannot evaluate economic impact without knowing how much stake moves at each tier. Emit vague_kpi red flag.

reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal text: 'The proposal requests six-month temporary control of Steward parameters enabling responsive stake cap management' with automatic revocation unless renewed. WHO exercises this control is not specified.
reasoning_trace.inference: This grants operational authority over stake caps but to an unnamed entity. Per severity calibration, this is high severity (NEW/unspecified control). Emit backdoor_permission red flag.

reasoning_trace.observation: Text states 'Contingency: This JIP depends on JIP-27 passage.' JIP-27 specifications are not included in proposal text. No fallback or modification handling described.
reasoning_trace.inference: If JIP-27 fails, changes, or defines different infrastructure, this proposal's execution could break. JIP-27 details needed for full evaluation.

reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal explicitly states 'Cost: No direct DAO expenditure.' Stake delegation reallocates existing JitoSOL resources rather than spending treasury funds.
reasoning_trace.inference: Treasury direction is 'none' - no outflow, inflow, or net transfer of funds out of treasury.

summary: JIP-28 allocates JitoSOL stake to validators running BAM software via tiered delegation based on adoption thresholds. Requests temporary six-month Steward parameter control. Depends on JIP-27. No direct treasury expenditure.
